observations: Orange gas cylinder with a black mesh netting around the body.
A regulator is attached to the top of the cylinder in photo 1.
The cylinder has a handle and a valve assembly.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the cylinder body in either photo.
The cylinder appears to be in used condition with some surface wear.

claims.evidence: The weight and regulator are not visible on the cylinder in the photos; no markings confirm the 12.5kg capacity.
This is a logistical claim that cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamp on the cylinder body.

risks.risk: The regulator may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the regulator's valve and threads.

risks.risk: The cylinder may have a high pressure rating (over 12.5kg) or a damaged base.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder base and a pressure test certificate.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamp on the cylinder body.
Close-up photo of the regulator's valve and threads.
Photo of the cylinder base and any pressure test certificate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
